rules.boundDescription: Only exact reviewed three-question v3 or four-question v4 text routing protocols. State <=6000 characters; request <=32768 bytes. Conservative envelope: four evaluations each charged up to the published 262144-token model context at USD 0.042/M input; ceil(4*262144*0.042)=44041 USD micros. Output free. No images, assets, arbitrary extra questions, plugins, retries, fallback or user-controlled provider policy. This reservation bound is not an estimate of typical spend.
